title: Place every feature test beneath its feature and test-kind directory

facts.note: <test_root> is the `topology:` key `test_root` in atdd-bun.yaml; only when that key is not configured does it default to `tests/wagons`. Not an additional root.
Every test file beneath the resolved test_root, whether changed in this diff or already present (existing violations included).

Precondition: the plan under the resolved plan_root (`topology.plan_root`, default `plan`) models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT; needs an observer that reads the plan. Plan-only changes can create or invalidate violations, so the plan is re-read on every run.
Whole-tree scan by the atdd_topology validator comparing each test's path with the plan's wagons/features; independent of which files the diff touched.

Header-only and binding-only violations of the same source statement (missing/mismatched URN; missing Acceptance header, unknown acceptance, or acceptance not declared by a WMBT the test's own feature lists). Produced by the same atdd_topology whole-tree scan; they activate the split rules in splitSuggestion, which share this rule's plan precondition, test_root scope and exclusions.

fires: The plan models at least one wagon/feature/WMBT, and any test beneath the resolved test_root (new, moved or pre-existing and untouched) sits outside `<test_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/{unit,contract,integration}/`.

The plan models at least one wagon/feature/WMBT, and a plan-only change (e.g. renaming or removing a feature) leaves an unchanged test beneath test_root in a path that no longer names a feature of its wagon.

The plan models at least one wagon/feature/WMBT, test_root is not configured, and a test beneath the default `tests/wagons` is not under a `<wagon>/features/<feature>/{unit,contract,integration}/` directory.

(Split rule test-urn-header) The plan models at least one wagon/feature/WMBT and a correctly placed test beneath test_root has no `URN: test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` header, or one whose wagon/feature does not match its path.

(Split rule test-acceptance-binding) The plan models at least one wagon/feature/WMBT and a correctly placed test beneath test_root has no `Acceptance:` header, names an acceptance that does not exist, or names one whose declaring WMBT is not listed by the test's own feature.
doesNotFire: The plan models no wagon, feature or WMBT yet.
Files inside vendored or generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated), even beneath test_root.
Files outside the resolved test_root (e.g. under source_root or e2e_root), including `tests/wagons` when test_root is configured to a different directory.

given: The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and tests exist beneath <test_root> (atdd-bun.yaml `topology.test_root`, default `tests/wagons`), outside vendored/generated trees.
when: You add, move or keep any test beneath <test_root>, or change the plan — existing tests are in scope too.
then: Every test beneath <test_root> lives beneath `<test_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/{unit,contract,integration}/`, in the directory of the feature it tests and the kind of test it is.
prefer: Move the test beneath its feature under unit/, contract/ or integration/ according to the kind of test it is, and add the test URN and Acceptance header.
avoid: Placing tests in a path that does not state their feature and test kind (unit/contract/integration).
Leaving a test without `URN: test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` matching its wagon/feature path (mandatory; split rule test-urn-header).

Leaving a test without `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}`, or binding one that does not exist or is not declared by a WMBT that the test's own feature explicitly lists (mandatory; split rule test-acceptance-binding).
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: A test proves an acceptance only when it names one that exists; its path says which feature and which kind of test it is.
evidence: The atdd_topology validator, run over the whole resolved test_root against the current plan, reports no path, URN or acceptance-binding finding.
The rule has a failing fixture demonstrating a misplaced/unbound test, as required of every package rule.
verifier_detail: Rule applies only when the plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT; then it covers every test beneath <test_root>, not only changed files.

Roots come from the `topology:` keys `plan_root`, `source_root`, `test_root`, `e2e_root` in `atdd-bun.yaml` (defaults `plan`, `src/wagons`, `tests/wagons`, `e2e` apply only when a key is not configured).

The source statement also requires, for every such test, the header `URN: test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` and `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` declared by a WMBT that the test's own feature lists; the same validator checks these and reports them as header-only / binding-only findings (split rules in splitSuggestion).
Implemented by validator `atdd_topology`; severity 3; package rule, strict disposition (every finding fails).
audit: Package rule (term package_rule): a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node; held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
Term topology_settings: the `topology:` keys plan_root, source_root, test_root, e2e_root in atdd-bun.yaml (defaults plan, src/wagons, tests/wagons, e2e).
Original name/summary: Feature tests live beneath their feature and bind a declared acceptance.
Original statement bundles three obligations (path, URN header, acceptance binding); this rewrite keeps path in `then` and realizes the other two as fully specified split rules in splitSuggestion.

facts.note: All tests beneath test_root, changed or not.
Same plan precondition as the parent rule.
atdd_topology whole-tree scan: URN header missing or wagon/feature not matching the test's path.

fires: Plan models a wagon/feature/WMBT and a test beneath test_root (even correctly placed) lacks a URN header or its URN names a different wagon/feature than its path.

splitSuggestion.given: The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and tests exist beneath <test_root> outside vendored/generated trees.
splitSuggestion.when: You add, move or keep any test beneath <test_root>, or change the plan.
splitSuggestion.then: Every test beneath <test_root> carries `URN: test:{wagon}:{feature}:{acceptance}` matching the wagon and feature of its path.
prefer: Add the test URN header naming the test's wagon, feature and acceptance.
avoid: Omitting the URN header, or a URN whose wagon/feature differs from the test's directory.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
splitSuggestion.why: A test proves an acceptance only when it names one that exists.

facts.note: All tests beneath test_root, changed or not.
Same plan precondition as the parent rule; plan-only changes re-evaluate bindings.
atdd_topology whole-tree scan: Acceptance header missing, acceptance unknown, or its declaring WMBT not listed by the test's own feature.

fires: Plan models a wagon/feature/WMBT and a test beneath test_root (even correctly placed) has no Acceptance header, names a nonexistent acceptance, or names one declared only by a WMBT its own feature does not list.
A plan-only change removes a WMBT from a feature's list, leaving an unchanged test bound to an acceptance that feature no longer lists.

splitSuggestion.given: The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and tests exist beneath <test_root> outside vendored/generated trees.
splitSuggestion.when: You add, move or keep any test beneath <test_root>, or change the plan.
splitSuggestion.then: Every test beneath <test_root> binds `Acceptance: acc:{wagon}:{acceptance}` declared by a WMBT that the test's own feature lists.
prefer: Add the Acceptance header naming an acceptance declared by a WMBT explicitly listed by the test's own feature.
avoid: Binding an acceptance that does not exist, or one declared by a WMBT the test's own feature does not list (e.g. only another feature's WMBT).
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
splitSuggestion.why: A test proves an acceptance only when it names one that exists.
